create_AlignmentExtractor: create an AlignmentExtractor model with a specified aligner model name and optional unit extractor
run_extract_alignment: run extract_alignment on an audio file and text to produce alignment durations and tokenized text
run_extract_units: run extract_units on a prepared audio tensor to extract discrete speech units
run_detokenize_text: run detokenize_text on tokenized text ids to decode them back into readable text
run_plot_alignment: run plot_alignment to visualize audio waveform with alignment tick marks over text tokens
